notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: config.json NemotronHForCausalLM: 52 layers; layers_block_type has 23 mamba + 23 moe + 6 'attention', and only those 6 keep per-token KV (Mamba-2 holds a fixed state). 6 x 2 kv_heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K,V) x 2 B bf16 = 6,144 B/token - the reason 256K fits on one H100. The MTP draft layer is excluded. ctx = max_position_embeddings 262,144 (card quotes 1M only for multi-GPU/Blackwell). REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row.
